extensionDescription.message: Shows unconfirmed email invitations as non-blocking calendar events.

historyCancellationReviewOpened.message: Scanned $DAYS$ days: opened $COUNT$ cancellation(s) for review.

confirmClear.message: Remove all pending events created by Invite Preview?

historyScanComplete.message: Scanned $DAYS$ days: added or updated $COUNT$ invitation(s).

historyScanNothing.message: Scanned $DAYS$ days: no new invitation found.

calendarMissing.message: No matching writable calendar is available.

scanNoCalendarPartial.message: Added or updated $ADDED$ invitation(s); $SKIPPED$ had no matching writable calendar.

historyScanNoCalendarPartial.message: Scanned $DAYS$ days: added or updated $ADDED$ invitation(s); $SKIPPED$ had no matching writable calendar.

calendarUnresponsive.message: The target calendar is not responding. Restart Thunderbird and try again.

historyScanCalendarPartial.message: Scanned $DAYS$ days: added $COUNT$ invitation(s). The target calendar then stopped responding.

historyScanPartial.message: Scanned $DAYS$ days: added $COUNT$ invitation(s); $ERRORS$ message(s) could not be read.

historyScanReadErrors.message: Scanned $DAYS$ days: no invitations added; $ERRORS$ message(s) could not be read.

operationFailed.message: The operation could not be completed.

removePreviewsPartial.message: Removed $REMOVED$ preview(s); $FAILED$ could not be removed.

cancellationReviewSummary.message: Events remain in their calendars until you remove them.

noCancellationReviews.message: There are no cancellations to review.

confirmDeleteAllCancellations.message: Remove all $COUNT$ cancelled events from their calendars?

cancellationDeleted.message: The event was removed from its calendar.

cancellationsDeletePartial.message: Removed $DELETED$ event(s); $FAILED$ could not be removed.

cancellationDismissed.message: The event was kept and the notice was dismissed.

cancellationMismatch.message: The calendar event no longer matches this cancellation and was not removed.

cancellationDeleteFailed.message: The event could not be removed. It remains available for another attempt.
